description: FREE. Finds voluntarily published business profiles for customers seeking tradespeople, cleaners or real-world services in an area. Qualifications are self-declared; no appointment is guaranteed. Country is ISO alpha-2; region is a coarse city/region name rather than a street address.

after.description: Pagination cursor from the previous response; leave empty for the first page and preserve the other search filters.
after.title: After

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code for the requested service area, such as AT. Supply is limited to profiles actually returned.
country.title: Country

limit.description: Maximum number of results on this page, from 1 to 100.
limit.title: Limit

region.description: Coarse city or region name, such as wien; do not put a private street address in a public search.
region.title: Region

trade.description: Stable trade ID returned by service_trade_catalog, such as plumbing or home-cleaning; not a free-text business name.
trade.title: Trade

name: find_service_providers
title: Passende Dienstleister finden
